fields.label: Shukhee Consent
fields.description: Which language row (Shukhee Consent.lng) this snapshot was taken from.

fields.label: Language
fields.description: Denormalized copy of shukhee_consent.lng, so list views can filter by language without following the link.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: The human-entered version label, copied verbatim from Shukhee Consent.version at the moment this snapshot was taken.

fields.label: Consent
fields.description: Immutable HTML snapshot of Shukhee Consent.consent at the moment this version was saved -- never edited after creation. This is what Call Logs.consent_version / Shukhee Consent Log.consent_version actually link to, so a historical call or decision always resolves to the exact wording that was live when it happened, not whatever Shukhee Consent currently holds.

fields.label: Consent Items
fields.description: Immutable snapshot of Shukhee Consent.consent_items at the moment this version was saved -- same child doctype reused from Shukhee Consent, built as plain dicts in ShukheeConsent.on_update (never the live row's own child Document instances). record_consent_decision resolves its authoritative item list from here, not from the live Shukhee Consent row, since this call can happen long after the live row was edited again.
